_comment: Calculator settings. Edit numbers here, no code changes needed. Amounts in USD unless the key says EUR/UAH.

fx._comment: Live rates come from the National Bank of Ukraine (bank.gov.ua). These are used only if that service is unavailable.

auctionFee._comment: Approximate buyer fees at US salvage auctions (fee + online bidding + gate fees). Linear between points; above the last point: rate * price + plus.

shipping._comment: Delivery to Klaipėda = land transport from the car's location to a US port + markupPerLocationUsd + that port's container price. The calculator picks the cheapest port and shows one total. locations[].land holds the forwarder's land price to each port; reload it with: node scripts/import-locations.mjs <price-list URL or saved page>. Oversized vehicles are quoted individually.

services._comment: Car Franko's own prices. PLACEHOLDERS — replace with the real ones.
services.deliveryToUkraineLabel: Доставка з Литви до Івано-Франківська власним автовозом

customs._comment: Ukrainian rules for passenger cars, 2026. Customs value = car price + auction fee + shipping to the EU port.

pensionFund._comment: Fee at first registration in Ukraine, % of the car's value without VAT. Thresholds in subsistence minimums (2026: 3328 UAH). Electric-only cars are exempt.

_states_comment: Each state: [name, port used only when the state has no locations in the price list].
